answer: Unique Sensor-Trace Attestation. Each agent identity must continuously submit raw ambient sensor streams (barometric drift, thermal noise, RF zephyr readings) that only one physical device can produce without detectable duplication. A control harbor reconciles traces against hardware silicon fingerprints, rejecting clones that replay or synthesize. Attackers must procure and operate distinct physical hardware per identity; forging traces costs more than buying a fresh device, and the nectar of shared sensor physics cannot be faked at scale.
